raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Raise the MLflow minimum to 3.17.2 and update MLflow, mlflow-skinny, and mlflow-tracing in the lockfile to address CVE-2026-53995.
- Resolve filelock to 4.2.4, above the 4.2.1 fix for CVE-2026-112940.
- Override the transitive filelock requirement because multi-storage-client 0.51.0 still declares `filelock<4`.

## Validation
- Regenerated `uv.lock` in the NVIDIA PyTorch 26.09 container; only MLflow family and filelock package versions changed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Compatibility note
The filelock override crosses multi-storage-client's declared upper bound. Please validate its file locking paths in CI before merging. Remove the override when multi-storage-client supports filelock 4.

Advisories: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wqmh-qccw-pqwf and https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/security/advisories/GHSA-v4x8-3wr5-3wq8

Auto-sync is disabled for draft pull requests in this repository. Workflows must be run manually.

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/auto-sync).

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=none -->

Completed the light static review of [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/pyproject.toml#L97-L151) and [uv.lock](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/uv.lock#L1-L45), including affected logging, storage, and container-install paths. No verified blocking or non-blocking findings.

The MLflow declarations and three locked MLflow packages consistently select 3.17.2. The inspected marker simplifications remain behind unchanged parent exclusions; they do not establish an installation regression.

Tests were not executed. External dependency implementations were unavailable, so filelock 4 compatibility with multi-storage-client and revision-3 handling by the pinned uv remain runtime-validation limitations. The filelock topic was re-inspected directly because its delegated detailed report was unavailable.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_locked_sync_linux_amd64` (proposed): run the [Docker locked-sync commands](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/docker/Dockerfile.ci#L249-L255) with pinned uv 0.7.2; expect success without rewriting the lockfile or replacing excluded base-runtime packages.
- `test_locked_sync_linux_arm64` (proposed): repeat on the supported ARM64 container with the same expected outcome.
- `test_msc_filelock4_cache_contention` (proposed): configure a real MSC cached backend and have two processes fetch the same fixture object into a shared temporary cache; expect correct bytes from both processes, serialized cache updates, and successful lock release and reacquisition.
- [`test_jsonl_memmap_dataset_with_msc_url`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/tests/functional_tests/test_groups/data/datasets/test_utils.py#L266-L284): retain successful sample reads and existence checks for both index sidecars.
- `test_mlflow_3172_logging_smoke` (proposed): use a temporary SQLite tracking database, log parameters, a step-qualified metric and a checkpoint artifact, then end the run as `FAILED`; query back each value, artifact and status.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

Completed the same-head follow-up to review 5645028601. The previously reviewed head and current head are identical (`46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10`). That review reported no findings, and there are no subsequent changes to assess. No blocking or non-blocking findings remain within this follow-up scope.

Narrow inspection of [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/pyproject.toml#L97-L151) and [uv.lock](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/uv.lock#L1-L45) supports the prior declaration-consistency observations. This was not a fresh whole-PR review. Tests were not executed; the previously noted filelock/MSC and pinned-uv compatibility limitations remain unvalidated, not established defects.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_locked_sync_linux_amd64` (proposed): run the supported container's locked sync; expect success without lockfile changes or replacement of excluded base-runtime packages.
- `test_locked_sync_linux_arm64` (proposed): repeat in the supported ARM64 container with the same expected outcomes.
- `test_msc_filelock4_cache_contention` (proposed): fetch one fixture object concurrently through an MSC shared cache from two processes; expect correct bytes, serialized cache updates, and successful lock release and reacquisition.
- `test_mlflow_3172_logging_smoke` (proposed): use a temporary SQLite tracking database, log a parameter, step-qualified metric and fixture artifact, then end the run as `FAILED`; expect the exact values, artifact contents and status on retrieval.
- No perf tests impacted.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=none -->

Completed the light static review of [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/pyproject.toml#L97-L151) and [uv.lock](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/uv.lock#L1-L45), including affected logging, storage, and container-install paths. No verified blocking or non-blocking findings.

The MLflow declarations and three locked MLflow packages consistently select 3.17.2. The inspected marker simplifications remain behind unchanged parent exclusions; they do not establish an installation regression.

Tests were not executed. External dependency implementations were unavailable, so filelock 4 compatibility with multi-storage-client and revision-3 handling by the pinned uv remain runtime-validation limitations. The filelock topic was re-inspected directly because its delegated detailed report was unavailable.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_locked_sync_linux_amd64` (proposed): run the [Docker locked-sync commands](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/docker/Dockerfile.ci#L249-L255) with pinned uv 0.7.2; expect success without rewriting the lockfile or replacing excluded base-runtime packages.
- `test_locked_sync_linux_arm64` (proposed): repeat on the supported ARM64 container with the same expected outcome.
- `test_msc_filelock4_cache_contention` (proposed): configure a real MSC cached backend and have two processes fetch the same fixture object into a shared temporary cache; expect correct bytes from both processes, serialized cache updates, and successful lock release and reacquisition.
- [`test_jsonl_memmap_dataset_with_msc_url`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/46cd803058d57c213e586fef42ddb57ad0d60f10/tests/functional_tests/test_groups/data/datasets/test_utils.py#L266-L284): retain successful sample reads and existence checks for both index sidecars.
- `test_mlflow_3172_logging_smoke` (proposed): use a temporary SQLite tracking database, log parameters, a step-qualified metric and a checkpoint artifact, then end the run as `FAILED`; query back each value, artifact and status.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
